rule: Requirements are not evidence of implementation. Status may advance only with source, tests, and exact-SHA evidence.

status_definitions.DETECTED: A source declaration or artifact was found; semantics are not yet validated.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Code exists and is connected to the intended runtime path.
status_definitions.VERIFIED: Required tests/gates passed on the exact source SHA with run/job/step/log/artifact evidence.
status_definitions.RESIDUAL: Known gap, failure, conflict, or missing evidence remains.

cross_system_rules: ShivaCore is the capability microkernel/TCB; networking, AI and contract execution belong outside the TCB unless an approved architecture decision says otherwise.
A-TownChain owns canonical ledger and state transition.
Production ATC-VM is a-townchain/components/vm; atc-vm is specification/support unless registry governance changes ownership.
Production ATC-Algorithm is a-townchain/components/algorithm; atc-algorithm is specification/support unless registry governance changes ownership.
ATC-Lang compiles to the canonical VM target; it does not define a second VM.
Aurora follows intent/proposal -> policy -> capability check -> approval where required -> tool -> service boundary -> authoritative runtime.
Genesis Engine optional integrations with AI or chain must use explicit service APIs and cannot bypass security boundaries.
When code, standards, or repository registry disagree, record a RESIDUAL and resolve through governance; do not silently choose.
